evidence: Swap test fails: a seed library, toy library or community-centre room booking could reuse every identity-carrying element unchanged (pale green-grey ground, white bordered cards, one green filled button, a wrench glyph beside the name in bold body text, the same wrench placeholder thumbnail on all ten tool cards). Only the copy (tool names, deposits, 'Saturday 10:00 to 13:00') is bound to this product.

Category-guess test fails: predicted default for a volunteer-run community service reservation is a GOV.UK-like public-service form (single humanist sans, one civic green, bordered cards, underlined links, radio-card lists); the render matches it element for element on find, basket and confirm.

Similar-prompt test fails: a brief for 'a parish hall booking for a village choir' would plausibly produce the same frame; the only element closer to this brief is the pick-up calendar with 'Open' tags on session days, and it is a standard date grid.
No signature: the first viewport of find (1280-light) is heading, intro paragraph, search field, then a grid of identical cards; nothing in it could only exist for a tool library except the words.

unfinished: Placeholder thumbnails on show: every tool card on find carries the identical wrench glyph in a pale square instead of a picture or a tool-specific drawing (items-ladder-3m/default/1280-light, 375-light).
Identity is only the name in bold body text with a small wrench glyph in the masthead; no focal point on any screen.
Sections that are only a heading and text: 'Opening times' on find, 'What happens next' on done, the details list on tool.

Empty bands at wide widths: basket and done at 1280 end with the footer two-thirds down and a flat grey band below; confirm form and done 'What happens next' box use only the left half of a 1088 px container.
Mobile masthead wraps the nav into stranded two-line labels ('Find a / tool', 'Basket / (1)', 'Opening / times') at 375.
Sticky reserve bar sits over the calendar and its own instructions in the tool screenshots, and its button overhangs the content column at 1280 (tool/default/1280-light, day-chosen/375-light).
Headings differ from body largely by size and weight only; one face, one weight pairing, no typographic moment.
evidence: find 1280-light first viewport: H1 'Find a tool', grey intro, full-width search, then ten cards with identical wrench squares and green 'Available from' pills; orderly but nothing to look at.
basket 1280-light: one card, then six session radio cards laid out as one full-width card plus five in a row, ending in a bare grey band.
done 1280-light: a definition list box and a half-width text box; no moment that marks the reservation as made.
Clean and consistent across light and dark themes; dark theme composed (cards lighter than ground), so it is not unappealing, only bare.
